releaseNotes:
1. Optimized radar algorithm to fix abnormal detection in corner, wall mounting, lying in bed, or pendant light scenarios; optimized coordinate jitter and positioning packet loss issues
2. Current count is enabled by default; supports the latest Matter specification, including count statistics and real-time area current count capability
3. Optimized parameter synchronization and retry logic for下发; improved stability of area configuration and initialization synchronization
4. Adjusted height unit and entry/exit logic for areas; optimized device sleep to reduce reporting duration
